description: This is a test source file for a TensorFlow Go API example demonstrating image recognition with a pre-trained inception model. It includes functions for loading the model, processing images, and performing inference, along with setup code and utility functions.

methods.name: Example
methods.description: Main example demonstrating loading a model, processing an image, running inference, and printing the top label.

methods.name: printBestLabel
methods.description: Outputs the label with the highest probability.

methods.name: makeTensorFromImage
methods.description: Converts an image file into a normalized Tensor suitable for the model.

methods.name: constructGraphToNormalizeImage
methods.description: Builds a TensorFlow graph to normalize and resize an image for inference.

methods.name: modelFiles
methods.description: Downloads and retrieves model files for the Inception model.

methods.name: readLabelsFile
methods.description: Reads label strings from a file.

methods.name: argmax
methods.description: Finds the index of the maximum value in a slice of float32.
